note:
The NAMED, shrink-only exemption list for the PRE-MANDATE MILESTONED backlog (issue #1694). The board check enforces the `required` metadata (class, type, priority, area) on every OPEN + MILESTONED issue. The un-milestoned backlog predates that convention and is counted, not failed; so does this one — it was filed before the mandate reached the board, `class:enterprise` (the policy's `filing.default_class`) was backfilled on all of it, and `priority`/`area` have NO honest bulk default: `area` is a functional classification the policy declares no universal value for, and a guessed value is wrong data every later tool would trust. UNLIKE the un-milestoned seam, this one is EXPLICIT and BY NAME: an issue is excused only while it is listed below, with its own `reason` and `owner`, and only for the UNDECLARED-metadata codes (`class-missing`, `classification-incomplete`). A declared-but-wrong class (`class-unknown`) or an ambiguous one (`class-ambiguous`) is never excused: an exemption covers what the board never recorded, not what it got wrong. There is no broad grandfather and no predicate a new issue could inherit — an issue that is NOT named here and is missing a required dimension FAILS BY NAME, so a newly filed issue is never absorbed.

Four assertions keep this list honest, and each can genuinely fail (GR-12):
1. SIZE — the list carries exactly `expected` entries. An entry added without an outstanding debt, or a debt cleared without its entry removed, fails by name.
2. APPLIED — every entry must excuse a debt THIS RUN: an entry whose issue is no longer OPEN + MILESTONED, or which now declares every required dimension, is reported as a STALE exemption naming itself (code `conformance-exemption-stale`).
3. OWNER — every entry names an `owner` (the issue that owns this triage) which must be OPEN in the same snapshot; when the owner closes, the entry lapses and the issue's own debt fails by name.
4. SCOPE — the exemption grants nothing to a non-exemptable finding, so an exempt issue that declares a class outside the ladder still fails.

The list can therefore only SHRINK toward the truth: remove an entry (and lower `expected`) as each issue is triaged; the check names exactly the entries to remove. The entries were MEASURED from the committed board snapshot (the artifact the gate reads), not authored.

tracking.renewal: re-read every entry's `owner` and update tracking.measured_at, or retire the entry; an owner that is no longer OPEN lapses the entry.
